friction.summary: High precision fields round trip in scientific notation: DebtMaximum written as 1000000000000 reads back as 1e12, which BigInt rejects, breaking every market created that way
Escrowing a permissioned MPT to a non member of its domain returns tecNO_PERMISSION, a cause absent from the three listed in XLS-0085
OfferCreate TakerGets and TakerPays exclude MPT amounts, so XLS-65 vault shares cannot trade on the DEX and a bespoke escrow order book was required
Bundled WalletConnect gates 22 relay call sites on navigator.onLine alone and throws No internet connection detected without making any request
Bounds on the repayment schedule are undocumented; probing showed PaymentInterval at least 60s, GracePeriod at most PaymentInterval, and no upper limit at all

single_fix: State every cause of tecNO_PERMISSION for MPT escrows in XLS-0085, including permissioned domain membership of the destination, and distinguish it from tecNO_AUTH. That code carried at least four distinct meanings across three transaction types in this period and was the largest single time sink.
